resources.string: This reconciles existing member records. It does not activate or deactivate accounts. Reserve changes follow the ordinary shift rules.

Explain the force majeure that requires these two delivery lead shifts less than ten weeks apart. Authorization applies only to this pair and proposal; other published shifts stay unchanged.

This permanent departure cancels the pending credits shown above and releases their reservations. Inactivity alone does not cancel credits. Existing credit history is kept; returning later does not restore cancelled credits.

Apply the account situation to both reserve pools and affected future shifts. Ordinary rules determine reserve entry or exit; this action does not choose a substitute or publish a new rotation. Pending credits are kept unless permanent departure has already been recorded.
